name: harden_generated_child_from_orchestrator_queue
prompt: Make S3 from this spec-orchestrator hardening queue implementation-ready using the parent spec and accepted S1/S2 verification pattern.
expected_output: Reads parent and predecessor specs, adds parent conformance, normative contract, canonical examples/fixtures decision, concrete harness cases, inherited verification commands, DoR/DoD, content-quality review, auto-resolve result, and a final readiness verdict.

name: stop_for_missing_contract_decision
prompt: Harden this child spec, but the parent does not decide which entitlement statuses are allowed for managed updates.
expected_output: Marks a DECISION blocker instead of inventing entitlement behavior, keeps parent conformance visible, and returns NEEDS USER DECISION rather than IMPLEMENTATION READY.

name: do_not_accept_thin_child_spec
prompt: This child spec has scope, acceptance criteria, and one generic test command. Is it ready to implement?
expected_output: Reports NEEDS HARDENING because normative contract depth, concrete harness cases, hardened verification commands, DoR/DoD, and evidence/status provenance are missing.

name: contract_heavy_fixture_decision
prompt: Harden a child spec that defines a bundle manifest with hashes, signatures, entitlement fields, and update metadata.
expected_output: Classifies the child as contract-heavy, chooses embedded examples, referenced fixtures, or hybrid, states required fixture paths/cases/normative fields, and does not mark implementation-ready if no canonical example or fixture strategy exists.
